_source: Tagirdzhanova et al. 2025, BMC Biology, 'A reference metagenome sequence of the lichen Cladonia rangiformis', DOI 10.1186/s12915-025-02428-z. Named compounds and BGC heatmap from Figure 6 / Results section.
_notes: The paper detects a wider BGC catalogue (T1/T2/T3PKS, NRPS, terpene, RiPP, etc.) in the mycobiont with named hits to the listed compounds.
Outperforming means: (a) recovering all named BGCs below, AND (b) producing additional well-supported orphan BGCs flagged with calibrated novelty scores.
